# `gcp.cloudtasks.queue`

A named resource to which messages are sent by publishers.

[cloudtasks](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | cloudtasks |
| Scope | regional |
| Asset type | `cloudtasks.googleapis.com/Queue` |
| Hangs off | `projects` |
| Tier | 1 (ruled: post_create and post_update (cloud_tasks_queue_state.go.tmpl) call :pause or :resume when Terraform's `desired_state` field changes. That field is Terraform's; the API's `state` is output-only, so THE BOUNDED GAP is that a queue cannot be paused from configuration here.
) |
| Mutation timeout | 60s |
